claim_scope: cold-start full-catalog recommendation only; no broad SOTA claim is allowed unless every required evidence method is complete
dropoutnet_fairness_rule: If official_dropoutnet is used as a candidate feature or rerank anchor, an official_dropoutnet_fixed comparator using exactly this config is mandatory; a separately tuned official_dropoutnet comparator is also mandatory as a stronger baseline.

official_melt.claim_limitation: MELT is a long-tailed sequential recommendation method whose official item branch requires train item-contexts; it is excluded from zero-interaction item-cold full-catalog SOTA claims only when the same-split audit proves every strict-fold cold item has zero train context.

significance.correction: Holm within dataset across candidate-vs-baseline comparisons

notes: This protocol intentionally revokes the earlier pass if faithful MELT or TIGER/LIGER evidence is absent.
MELT may be excluded only through documented source-backed non-applicability to zero-interaction item-cold full-catalog ranking; proxy MELT evidence remains disallowed.
The prior 20260606-20260610 confirmatory run may be used only as exploratory evidence after this protocol is frozen.
Any new publication claim must use fresh confirmatory seeds and the frozen candidate/config before looking at those results.
After the full ablation audit, mask_seen_in_topm=true is mandatory for any publication candidate because the unmasked Fashion result was inflated.

Because the repaired masked candidate was selected after inspecting the 20260611-20260615 runs, those seeds are retired from publication approval. Fresh post-repair confirmatory seeds are 20260701-20260705.
